sources.role: official Qt source for settings, input, media and state paths
official Windows/Linux release and platform evidence

paths.naming: Qt QSettings IniFormat; MainWindow loads and saves QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath()/settings.ini.
input/p1/type, input/p1/0..17, input/p2/type, input/p2/0..17 and controller/joystickType (0 General, 1 PS, 2 Xbox). The physical joystick is not persisted; SimpleJoystick starts runtime index 0.

paths.path: Guest/media-dependent; no separate cartridge-save grammar is established by the pinned source.
paths.naming: No portable ADAM+ cartridge save filename is claimed.

paths.path: Configured statePath directory (default media/states); MainWindow appends the current ROM basename and .sta.
paths.naming: <rom-basename>.sta; the file path is user-selectable and persisted as statePath.

paths.path: Optional external paths bios/coleco, bios/eos, bios/writer; source also contains embedded BIOS arrays.
paths.naming: No single external BIOS filename/checksum is required by the pinned source.

paths.path: No external cryptographic key file interface is documented.
